description: This file defines the PlacementFilterDirectorResolver class, which is responsible for resolving instances of IPlacementFilterDirector based on PlacementFilterStrategy types within the Orleans runtime's placement filtering subsystem.

classes.name: PlacementFilterDirectorResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that provides IPlacementFilterDirector instances based on PlacementFilterStrategy types, using dependency injection.

methods.name: GetFilterDirector
methods.description: Returns an IPlacementFilterDirector instance corresponding to the provided PlacementFilterStrategy, utilizing the service provider.
